question: how to get vacation leave approved
answer: To get vacation leave approved, an employee must submit a leave application to the Head of the Department (HoD) at least three days in advance. The leave application should be submitted in the prescribed format and should be approved by the HoD before the leave can be taken.

question: how many casual leaves are permanent staff allowed per year
answer: A maximum of twelve casual leaves (CL) are permitted in a calendar year for permanent staff. Staff on probation instead have one casual leave created at the end of each month.
relevant_sources: CMRIT - Leave Information, Application and Approval Process - 7.7.2026.pdf

question: what is the maximum vacation leave per semester for staff who completed one year of service
answer: Staff who have completed one year of service (till the last working day of the semester) are permitted a maximum of seven working days of vacation leave per semester. Those who have completed six months of service are permitted a maximum of three working days, and no vacation leave is permitted for those with less than six months of service.
relevant_sources: CMRIT - Leave Information, Application and Approval Process - 7.7.2026.pdf

question: when do unused casual and vacation leaves expire
answer: Unutilized casual leaves, vacation leaves, OODs and OEDs as on 31st December shall lapse. Compensatory-off lapses at the end of three months from the corresponding working holiday.
relevant_sources: CMRIT - Leave Information, Application and Approval Process - 7.7.2026.pdf

question: what counts as half a casual leave for coming late
answer: Coming to work after fifteen minutes of the day start is considered as half CL. An employee also loses half CL if they are late up to fifteen minutes of the day start for three days in a month, and missing one of the biometric punch-in/punch-out is considered as half CL.
relevant_sources: CMRIT - Leave Information, Application and Approval Process - 7.7.2026.pdf

question: how long is the probation period for new employees at CMRIT
answer: The probation period at CMRIT is one year from the date of joining.

question: when does the probation completion process start in Darwinbox
answer: The probation completion process is automatically initiated in Darwinbox 30 days prior to the employee's probation end date, sending workflow notifications to the Reporting Manager and Deans (Academic Department) or the Reporting Manager and Vice Principal (Non-Academic Department).

question: does CMRIT provide PF and ESI benefits to staff
answer: Yes, all eligible employees, as per the statute, are entitled to PF and ESI facility.

question: what flexible working hours option do staff get
answer: Staff are given flexible working hours with a 1-hour window, subject to being available for scheduled activities. A Leave Work Early option is also provided to meet personal needs.

question: what compensatory off is given for working on a holiday
answer: Staff called for work on a holiday by the head of department/Vice Principal are provided compensatory-off of half a day for working four hours, and compensatory-off of one day for working eight hours.
relevant_sources: CMRIT - Leave Information, Application and Approval Process - 7.7.2026.pdf

question: what is CMRIT's quality policy
answer: CMRIT's Quality Policy is to deliver quality technical education to inculcate scientific temperament and social commitment in students, preparing them as inspired engineers partnering collective progress.

question: what does tyt stand for
answer: TYT stands for Touch Your 'TOES', where TOES stands for Thinking Outcome Experience of Students.

question: what are the responsibilities of the Director at CMRIT
answer: The Director leads functions, operations, and strategic/cross-functional initiatives; proposes a strategic roadmap; works with the leadership team in alignment with the institution's vision, mission and objectives; forms policies and detailed plans; works across departments to realize objectives; leads functional/virtual organizations across departments; interfaces with external parties and represents the institution; maintains stakeholder relationships; manages budgets and resources prudently; contributes to overall growth; and monitors and improves initiatives based on stakeholder feedback.

question: what is the head of department expected to focus on
answer: The Head of Department is expected to focus on the department's vision, mission and thrust areas by aligning all activities toward them, and to create a healthy, competitive ecosystem conducive to the growth of students, faculty, the department and the organization, including setting up processes and systems.

question: what mandatory training must new faculty complete within six months of joining
answer: Within six months, new faculty must complete CO-PO Computation Training, Paper & Proposal Writing Training, and Mentoring Process Guidelines during Orientation.
relevant_sources: Mandatory Training for New Faculty - Sheet1.pdf

question: how often is the faculty semester evaluation done
answer: The Faculty Semester Evaluation is done two times a year: in January for the July-December period, and in July for the January-June period.

question: what weightage do core activities like teaching and research carry in the faculty evaluation
answer: Core activities (such as Teaching, Research Papers, Consultancy, Research Proposals, Innovation and Entrepreneurship) carry a 60% weightage in the Faculty Semester Evaluation.
